title: imap TLS listener: accept IMAPS connections on port 993
description: Create crates/imap/src/server.rs. pub struct ImapServer { stores: Arc<ImapStores>, tls_acceptor: Arc<tokio_rustls::TlsAcceptor>, config: Arc<ImapConfig> }. pub struct ImapStores { pub article_numbers: Arc<ArticleNumberStore>, pub overview: Arc<OverviewStore>, pub ipfs: Arc<dyn IpfsBlockStore>, pub credential_store: Arc<CredentialStore>, pub pool: Arc<SqlitePool> }. impl ImapServer { pub async fn new(config: ImapConfig) -> Result<Self, String> { load TLS config via usenet_ipfs_tls::load_tls_server_config; open SQLite pool; run migrations; build credential_store from config.auth; build ArticleNumberStore + OverviewStore from reader crate; build ImapStores; wrap in Arc } pub async fn run(self) -> Result<(), String> { bind TcpListener on config.listen.addr; loop { accept() -> spawn session task } } }. In main.rs: parse --config arg, load ImapConfig, build ImapServer, call server.run().await.
